name: zmath_vec3_dir_from_yaw
description: zMath::Vec3DirFromYaw builds a unit XZ direction from a yaw angle.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x474580 validates that the function clears outDir, stages the canonical forward vector (0, 0, -1), calls zMath::Vec3RotateY with yawAngle, and returns.
The native zMath smoke verifies yaw 0 produces (0, 0, -1) and yaw pi/2 produces (-1, 0, 0), matching the Vec3RotateY-based XZ direction contract.
